organic_planning_philosophy.principle: Organic always wins - natural growth beats forced structure

what_organic_means.definition: Growth that emerges from need, not imposed from plan
what_organic_means.in_nature: Trees grow toward light, roots toward water - needs drive form
what_organic_means.in_asdfasdfa: Features emerge from actual usage, not hypothetical requirements

rule_1.name: Seed First
rule_1.description: Plant the minimal viable seed that enables growth

rule_2.name: Observe Before Expand
rule_2.description: Watch how seed is used before adding complexity

rule_3.name: φ Branching
rule_3.description: Each branch creates φ child branches - not more, not less

rule_4.name: Prune Dead Branches
rule_4.application: If feature has no usage after N time, remove it

organic_implementation_plan.philosophy: Instead of phases, we plant SEEDS that grow naturally

seed_1_data_connection.name: Root Seed - Data Flows
seed_1_data_connection.description: Connect brain to all data sources

minimal_viable.function: Pull K-Score data from HolDex API periodically

seed_1_data_connection.verification: Brain has fresh K-Score data for any queried token

seed_2_temporal.name: Time Seed - Decay & Evolution

minimal_viable.function: Decay unused patterns by φ⁻³ weekly
minimal_viable.trigger: Weekly cron or on pattern query
minimal_viable.storage: Update pattern strength in existing files

seed_2_temporal.verification: Old unused patterns have lower strength than fresh ones

seed_3_pollination.name: Cross Seed - Pattern Linking
seed_3_pollination.description: Similar patterns across projects link automatically

minimal_viable.function: On pattern creation, check similarity with existing patterns

seed_3_pollination.verification: Related patterns appear in context injection

seed_4_verification.name: Trust Seed - Merkle Proofs

minimal_viable.function: Generate Merkle tree from all patterns weekly

seed_4_verification.verification: Any pattern has provable inclusion in weekly root

seed_5_daat_levels.name: Wisdom Seed - 4 Levels
seed_5_daat_levels.verification: Complex queries get richer context than simple ones

seed_ordering.principle: Seeds planted in order of dependency and foundation importance

wave_1_foundation.reason: Root before branches - data and attribution first
wave_1_foundation.success_criteria: Brain has live HolDex data + contributor tracking

wave_3_verification.success_criteria: Knowledge is verifiable, enrichment is intelligent

avoid.why_wrong: No feedback loop, may build unused features
avoid.organic_way: Deploy each seed, observe, then grow

avoid.why_wrong: Incentivizing behavior that may not emerge
avoid.organic_way: Track contributions first, rewards emerge from value
Local Merkle first, on-chain when volume justifies

wave_1_metrics.usage: Brain queries increasing week over week

wave_3_metrics.trust: Users verify at least 10% of critical claims

conclusion.summary: Organic growth means planting minimal viable seeds and letting them grow based on actual usage and need. The plan is not a timeline but a DEPENDENCY GRAPH - each seed grows when its roots are strong.
conclusion.first_action: Plant Seed 1 (HolDex-Brain data sync) - the root of all intelligence
